catalog_quote: A Kienyang syllable contains at the minimum a vowel (V) and a tone (T); it may also contain an initial consonant (C), a medial (M), an offglide (O) and a final nasal segment (ŋ) ... 1.4 Tones ... What I have called tone nine (9) in Kienyang derives mostly from the yang-ping category ... Tones differ in pitch, length and contour. ... Chart III. Tones 1 [55] 2 [33] 3 [21] 5 [32] 6 [43] 7 [35] 8 [43] 9 [31] ... 1.5 Changed Tones Nothing corresponding to the changed tones of Cantonese occurs in this dialect. ... 1.7 Tone Sandhi This dialect has no tone sandhi. ... [Appendix, p. 303] Atonic syllables are preceded by a period.

tone_statements.quote: “弱化聲母＂和與四聲八調系統不符的調類是閩北方言引起廣泛學術興趣的兩大特點。這兩個現象互相關聯，且在中古音系中找不到來源。 ... 有三十三對分調調值比原調低。這類調值我用斜體標出來，比如建甌的陰平調。 只有一對分調調值比原調高，就是建陽陰去聲，表中用黑體標示。
tone_statements.translation: The 'softened initials' and the tone categories that do not fit the four-tone/eight-category system are the two features of the Min Bei dialects that have attracted wide scholarly interest. The two phenomena are interrelated, and no source for them can be found in the Middle Chinese sound system. ... In thirty-three pairs the split tone has a lower value than the original tone; I mark these values in italics, e.g. the yinping tone of Jian'ou. In only one pair is the split tone higher than the original, namely Jianyang yinqu, marked in bold in the table.

sources.note: Ch. 2 describes Jianyang Min phonology: 8 citation tones, TBU = syllable (printed pp. 24-25); instrumental study of tone in isolated vs connected forms. tone.says: The voiced onsets of Northern Min and their associated tonal reflexes (motivation for Norman's proto-Min softened stops) are re-examined; proposes that pre-Proto-Northern-Min kept early voiced onsets in Tone A2 with a conditioned split isolating voiced stops in Yangping yi 陽平乙 ('A2+', i.e. the 'ninth tone').

tone.quote: 以閩北建甌方言為例，同為中古漢語全濁聲母平聲字的「婆堂銅除池齊情群牌提」等與「婆 8 蹄茶槽牆錢晴」等字現代讀音的差別在聲調上，前者讀 21 調（陽平甲）後者讀 33 調（陽平乙），前後兩組字的聲母在建甌方言都讀作不送氣清音。 … 閩北建甌方言的「婆」字有三種讀音：pc21, pc33 與 phc33，分別為陽平甲調不送氣音、陽平乙調不送氣音與送氣音。 … 可以知道「婆」字的兩種讀音，「婆 pc21」與「婆 pc33」，並非「連讀變調」所造成的。
tone.translation: Taking Jian'ou (Northern Min) as the example: 婆堂銅除池齊情群牌提 and 婆蹄茶槽牆錢晴, all Middle Chinese voiced-obstruent ping-tone words, differ today in TONE: the former read tone 21 (Yangping-jia), the latter tone 33 (Yangping-yi); the initials of both groups are unaspirated voiceless in Jian'ou. … In Jian'ou 婆 has three readings, pɔ21, pɔ33 and phɔ33: Yangping-jia unaspirated, Yangping-yi unaspirated, and aspirated. … so the two readings of 婆, pɔ21 and pɔ33, are not produced by tone sandhi.
